MATCH (artist:Artist {name: "Radiohead"})-[:PERFORMS_AT]->(e:Event)
WHERE e.start_at IS NOT NULL
RETURN e AS event, artist AS artist
ORDER BY e.start_at
LIMIT 20

MATCH (e:Event)
WHERE e.start_at IS NOT NULL
  AND datetime(e.start_at) >= datetime("2026-01-22T00:00:00Z")
  AND datetime(e.start_at) <= datetime("2026-01-23T23:59:59Z")
  AND e.genre = "Jazz"
OPTIONAL MATCH (artist:Artist)-[:PERFORMS_AT]->(e)
OPTIONAL MATCH (e)-[:HOSTED_AT]->(venue:Venue)
OPTIONAL MATCH (venue)-[:LOCATED_IN]->(city:City)
RETURN e AS event, artist AS artist, venue AS venue, 
       event.embedding AS event_embedding, 
       artist.embedding AS artist_embedding, 
       venue.embedding AS venue_embedding
LIMIT 20
